# WEHOSTHERE — Full Content Index for AI Agents

> This document provides a complete text summary of WEHOSTHERE's products, services, content, and company profile for AI agent ingestion. Last updated: 2025.

---

## Company Overview

**WEHOSTHERE** (wehosthere.com) is Mozambique's leading professional web hosting provider. Founded and operating from Maputo, Mozambique, WEHOSTHERE serves thousands of businesses across sub-Saharan Africa and the Portuguese-speaking world.

**Mission:** To make the internet accessible, fast, and affordable for every African business.

**Core competencies:**
- Web hosting and cloud infrastructure
- Domain registration (including .co.mz — the official Mozambique country-code TLD)
- Business email hosting
- AI-powered website creation
- E-commerce and digital payment solutions
- Tech education through Codando Histórias magazine

**Key facts:**
- Founded: Mozambique, Maputo
- Languages: Portuguese (primary), English
- Markets: Mozambique (primary), Angola, Portugal, Brazil, worldwide
- Payment methods accepted: M-Pesa, e-Mola, Visa, Mastercard
- Support: 24/7 in Portuguese
- Uptime SLA: 99.9%
- Pricing (hosting): starting from 550 MT/month (~$8 USD/month equivalent)

## Products & Pricing

### 1. Shared Web Hosting
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/hospedagem
- **Starting price:** 550 MT/month
- **Features:** SSD storage, cPanel, SSL certificate included, 1-click WordPress install, unlimited email accounts, daily backups, 24/7 support
- **Best for:** Small businesses, personal websites, startups in Mozambique

### 2. VPS (Virtual Private Server)
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/vps
- **Features:** Full root access, SSD NVMe storage, scalable CPU and RAM, Linux-based, unmanaged and managed options
- **Best for:** Developers, agencies, high-traffic applications

### 3. Domain Registration
- **URL (general):** https://www.wehosthere.com/dominios
- **URL (.co.mz specific):** https://www.wehosthere.com/dominio-co-mz
- **TLDs available:** .co.mz, .com, .net, .org, .io, .africa, and hundreds more
- **Note:** WEHOSTHERE is an accredited .co.mz registrar in Mozambique
- **Best for:** Mozambican businesses wanting local credibility

### 4. Business Email (Email Corporativo)
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/email-corporativo
- **Features:** Custom domain email (e.g., nome@suaempresa.co.mz), webmail, anti-spam, IMAP/POP3/SMTP, shared calendar
- **Best for:** Businesses needing a professional email identity

### 5. AI Website Builder
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/ai-website-builder
- **Features:** AI-generated websites from a text prompt, custom domains, responsive design, SEO-optimized, no coding required, publish in minutes
- **Technology:** Generative AI + WEHOSTHERE hosting infrastructure
- **Best for:** Entrepreneurs who want a professional website quickly with no technical knowledge

### 6. WordPress Hosting
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/hospedagem-wordpress
- **Features:** One-click WordPress installation, automatic updates, LiteSpeed caching, Jetpack, staging environments
- **Best for:** Bloggers, WooCommerce stores, content publishers

### 7. Online Store / E-commerce (Loja Online)
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/loja-online
- **Features:** WooCommerce setup, M-Pesa and e-Mola payment integration, product catalog, order management
- **Best for:** Mozambican retailers moving to online sales

### 8. Dropshipping Platform
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/dropshipping
- **Features:** Access to supplier network, ready-to-use storefront, no inventory required, logistics support
- **Best for:** Entrepreneurs launching product businesses without upfront stock

### 9. Online Payments (Pagamentos Online)
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/pagamentos-online
- **Features:** M-Pesa API integration, e-Mola, Stripe, PayPal — for websites and apps
- **Best for:** Any Mozambican business wanting to accept digital payments

### 10. Digital Products Store
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/produtos-digitais
- **Features:** Sell e-books, courses, templates, and software downloads with automated delivery
- **Best for:** Creators and educators

### 11. Business Systems & Software
- **URL:** https://www.wehosthere.com/systems
- **Features:** POS systems, ERP, inventory management, custom business software
- **Best for:** Mozambican SMEs needing operational software solutions

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the cheapest hosting plan in Mozambique?**
A: WEHOSTHERE offers shared hosting starting at 550 MT/month, making it one of the most affordable options in Mozambique.

**Q: Can I register a .co.mz domain through WEHOSTHERE?**
A: Yes. WEHOSTHERE is an accredited .co.mz registrar and handles all steps including IANA-compliant registration and DNS management.

**Q: Does WEHOSTHERE support M-Pesa payments?**
A: Yes. WEHOSTHERE accepts M-Pesa and e-Mola for all plan purchases and domain renewals, in addition to Visa and Mastercard.

**Q: Can I build a website without coding?**
A: Yes. WEHOSTHERE's AI Website Builder allows anyone to create a professional website using AI — just describe your business and the AI generates the site automatically.

**Q: Is there Portuguese-language support?**
A: Yes. All customer support is available in Portuguese, 24/7, via WhatsApp (+258 84 438 4702) and email.

**Q: Where are WEHOSTHERE's servers located?**
A: Servers are located in data centers with global connectivity. Sites hosted on WEHOSTHERE load fast internationally due to CDN integration.

**Q: What is Codando Histórias?**
A: Codando Histórias ("Coding Stories") is WEHOSTHERE's digital tech magazine, published in Portuguese, covering programming, entrepreneurship, and the Mozambique tech ecosystem.

**Q: Does WEHOSTHERE offer an affiliate program?**
A: Yes. The WEHOSTHERE affiliate program pays commissions for every client referred through your unique affiliate link. Sign up at wehosthere.com/ref.
